items.synopsis: The Control Board and FPC will restart if the optics present in the first three ports of PTX10001-36MR draw 50W or more power
items.description: On Junos Evolved PTX10001-36MR with coherent optics QSFP56-DD-400G-ZR-M, QSFP56-DD-400G-ZR or QSFP56-DD-400G-ZR-HP, if the optics present in the first three ports draw combined power of 50w or more the power rail will experience fault, resetting the Control Board (CB) and Flexible PIC Concentrators (FPC). The entire device traffic will be impacted when CB and FPC go for a reset.

items.category: PFE COS features on BT based platforms
items.synopsis: More than 8 forwarding-classes cannot be configured with CBF
items.description: On PTX10001-36MR, error will be displayed when we commit more than 8 forwarding-classes (FCs) which are configured with Class Based Forwarding (CBF) even though the product supports upto 16 forwarding-classes configured with CBF.

items.category: PFE L2 forwarding features on BT based platforms
items.synopsis: IFBD lookup Failure in DLU, packets needs to be dropped rather than learned through control IFL in packetio.
items.description: Related to L2 level security fix.

items.category: PFE L2 forwarding features on BT based platforms
items.synopsis: Egress filter over IRB will not work
items.description: On Junos Evolved PTX10004, PTX10008, PTX10016, PTX10001-36MR platforms, an Integrated Routing and Bridging (IRB) egress filter does not work if the IRB is part of a VXLAN BD (Virtual Extensible Local Area Network based Bridge Domain).

items.synopsis: FPCs experiences crash and restart whenever the network encounters either an MPLS LSP flap or a LAG flap
items.description: On all Junos Evolved platforms face potential network instability due to two issues: FPC(Flexible PIC Concentrators) crashes during network flaps and brief disruptions during route updates with unilists

items.synopsis: LAG interfaces will take longer than usual to come up in a scaled scenario with ALB
items.description: On PTX10001, PTX10004, PTX10008 and PTX10016 platforms, if Adaptive load balancing (ALB) is configured on LAG interface, the LAG interfaces will take longer than usual to be up if they are all enabled in the same commit. LAG interfaces get stuck in 'attached' state. This issue happens in a scaled Link Aggregation Group (LAG) (~65 ae ) scenario.

items.synopsis: pfestatsd process may fail to restart when running out of file descriptors
items.description: pfestatsd process was running out of file descriptors when there are 16 FPCs in the system as the number of concurrent connections exceeded 1024

items.synopsis: Flabel sequencing is not correct leading to traffic loops and congestion in the PFE on PTX platforms
items.description: Flabel sequencing is not correct leading to traffic loops and congestion in the PFE on PTX platforms.

items.synopsis: Policy Based Routing will not work as intended when it is configured with 'next-ip/next-ip6' on all ACX Junos OS Evolved platforms except ACX7024
items.description: FIB (Forwarding Information Base) compression feature compresses multiple routes with the same unique forwarding behavior (such as forwarding next-hops) into a single route to save forwarding entries in hardware. If compression happens for route involving PBR (Policy Based Routing) configured 'next-ip/next-ip6' action, then PBR handling for forwarding nexthops gets impacted. PBR will not work properly with the traffic.

items.synopsis: Multicast traffic is not forwarded to the NG-MVPN core
items.description: On all Junos OS Evolved platforms, with Next-Generation Multicast Virtual Private Network (NG-MVPN) configured in the core and Ethernet Virtual Private Network (EVPN) in the access, multicast traffic from the EVPN sender is not forwarded to the NG-MVPN core as multicast next hop (NH) in Packet Forwarding Engine (PFE) has some programming issues resulting in traffic loss.

items.synopsis: Functionality provided by arp/ndp publish argument doesn't work on all Junos OS Evolved platforms
items.description: Functionality provided by publish argument for static arp and static ndp configuration is not working on all Junos OS Evolved platforms.

items.synopsis: Traffic drops will be seen on all Junos OS Evolved platforms
items.description: On all Junos OS Evolved platforms, while changing the MAC (Media Access Control ) address on the peer side, the traffic drop will be observed if route is in non-default table.

items.synopsis: monitor interface or show interface does not display the interface description
items.description: Enhancement in EVO platform for the command "monitor interface" and "show interface" include interface description

items.synopsis: In the EVPN-MPLS scenario traffic between CE devices will drop
items.description: On all Junos OS Evolved PTX platforms, in the Ethernet Virtual Private Network- Multiprotocol Label Switching (EVPN-MPLS) scenario, if the MPLS core interface is configured with a Virtual Local Area Network (VLAN) tag, then traffic between customer edge (CE) devices will get dropped.

items.synopsis: Gamora: CB goes into fault state after system RE power off/on using button press
items.description: CB power fault is seen when graceful PSU power off/on using button press. After power off when button is pressed to powered on, RE comes up and then when SW try to set the power up bit CPLD will not honor the request since it is already in set state.

items.synopsis: Some timing features do not work as intended with PLL input and lock failure alarms on Junos OS Evolved platforms after Routing and Control Board jack in and switchover
items.description: Some timing features (SyncE/PTP/TWAMP) do not work as expected and PLL (Phase-locked loop) input and lock failure alarms can occur on Junos OS Evolved platforms after the following sequence: 1. Insert an RCB (Routing and Control Board) in a running system (OR, remove and then insert back RCB in a running system). 2. Do Switchover after the new RCB is ready for switchover. This problem can be avoided using the workaround specified in the PR.

items.synopsis: Traffic flooding occurs when deactivating and activating interfaces in EVPN scenario
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms, while deactivating/activating the interface, the first control MAC for a BD and IFL combination can get lost when L2alm'd ifbd Mac sequence num is different from what is sent by L2ald. This will lead to traffic flooding for the MAC which will be impacted.

items.synopsis: RPD process crashes due to memory exhaustion
items.description: On all Junos, Junos-EVO platforms, When ISIS with IPv6 is enabled with addition there is link flap seen. With each link flap there will be a memory leak of 240 bytes. There is no service impact until all the system memory is exhausted, however when system memory is exhausted RPD restarts.

items.category: PTX10K Line Card specific interface PRs
items.synopsis: Interface stay in link DOWN state when using third party optics
items.description: On Junos OS Evolved platforms and MX ULC based line cards, interfaces will stay DOWN when using third party vendor optics, due to an incorrect programming of EEPROM when plugged into the device.

items.category: Issues related to control plane security
items.synopsis: Gamora RLI-52717: Observing continuous ssh errors on log messages(error: Could not load host key: /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ec_p521_key).
items.description: This is not an issue, the error messages seen are due to minor enhancement that we attempted to do on evo. However that enhancement is not working on all platforms. It also does not break any existing functionality.

items.synopsis: Config login class with allow/deny-configuration-regexps not working as expected with Routing-instances
items.description: Config login class with allow/deny-configuration-regexps not working as expected with Routing-instances

items.category: UI Infrastructure - mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL
items.synopsis: The device goes into configuration locked state due to stale mgd
items.description: The device is went into config locked state due to stale mgd. For netconf sessions with , if ungraceful exit happens, the lock is not released. There is auto cleanup supported for such cases, But it is not triggered under problem conditions as faced in this PR. This leads to device remain in locked state due to stale entry. "request system logout pid " can be used for cleanup and to recover from this state.

items.category: Issues related to YANG Data Models
items.synopsis: [manageability_mgd_infra] [all] NFX350 :: JUNOS_REG: NFX350: Getting RPC error while executing RPC command on the device.
items.description: Since it is a negative test case. There is no-impact and workaround is available

items.category: PFE L2 forwarding features on BT based platforms
items.synopsis: PTX10001-36MR: epp_epc_intr_shmem_err seen in logs
items.description: PTX10001-36MR : epp_epc_intr_shmem_err seen in logs

items.synopsis: Error messages are populating "getQosRewriteHwMapIdFromIflIndex" and interface ifd queue stats traffic is going to the wrong queue
items.description: ACX7509 :: Observing Error messages are populating "getQosRewriteHwMapIdFromIflIndex" and verify interface ifd queue stats traffic is going to wrong queue"

items.category: Alias for DHCP issue on DNX based platform.
items.synopsis: JDI_REG:EVO:ultron-xl: jdhcpd.re.re0 cored at trace_file_close_internal (traceptr=0x7efc443b2bb0) at ../../src/junos_trace.c:188
items.description: With DHCP trace options enabled in their regression scripts, this core was seen. Issue is random not seen always. This was enabled in script for debugging in production network this will not be enabled by default hence the issue will not be seen. Its recommended to enable DHCP trace options only for debugging not otherwise.

items.synopsis: Traffic drops observed in the L2Circuit/L2VPN scenario
items.description: On Junos Evolved ACX platforms, traffic drops are observed when an update is processed in the L2Circuit (Layer 2 Circuit)/L2VPN (Layer 2 VPN) scenario on executing the CLI command "clear isis database all". The issue happens due to the reuse of the same port resource when PFE (Packet Forwarding Engine) receives the deletion and addition of port resources.

items.synopsis: ACX7K || Post instance renaming, VPLS MACs stopped exchanging over MPLS CORE/LSI interface
items.description: During renaming of routing-instance some BD objects are not properly handled and are reaching PFE during delete. Because of which LSI interface is not getting created in the hardware as its waiting for the BD updates which already got deleted.

items.synopsis: Telemetry data is not exported in an IS-IS scaled Segment Routing scenario
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms configured with SR-ISIS and with gRPC/gNMI telemetry, subscription to the path: "/junos/services/segment-routing/sid/usage/" will not work and the output could not be proper. The issue could happen only in scaled configuration (Approximately, 4000 or more per-sid ingress sensors and 4000 or more IPv4/IPv6 per-sid egress sensors are configured).

items.synopsis: On QFX5130-48C, In rare situation, a vmcore might be seen on the device during bootup
items.description: On QFX5130-48C platform, when system is rebooted, on rare situation vmcore can be seen , however there is no service impact.

items.synopsis: Commit of "openconfig-interfaces:interfaces interface <> config openconfig-vlan:tpid <>" configuration fails with commit scripts error on glenrothes
items.description: Commit of "openconfig-interfaces:interfaces interface <> config openconfig-vlan:tpid <>" configuration fails with commit scripts error on glenrothes

items.category: Issues related to Junos licensing infrastructure
items.synopsis: [Junos OS Evolved] syslog - mgd[xxxx]: UI_COMMIT_PROGRESS: Commit operation in progress: cannot signal 'Alarm control process', signal 10, no pid
items.description: On Junos OS Evolved platforms, alarmd error is generated upon config commit.

items.synopsis: RPC request for file copy with routing instances is failing
items.description: On Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved platforms configured with routing instances, RPC (Remote Procedure Call) request for file copy using routing instance fails. There is no service/traffic impact due to this issue.

items.synopsis: High Scale for SPMSI NGMVPN on PTX1003 is not supported
items.description: In high scaled (beyond 14k s, g routes - 7k ipv4 and 7k ipv6 )NGMVPN SPMSI scenarios, core might be seen on PTX10003 platforms due to memory getting exhausted.
